page.content:
Bulls shooting guard of the first truly global dynasty.

How Michael Jordan connects

  • Faction: Chicago Bulls — Michael Jordan was the face of the Chicago Bulls dynasty.
  • Concept: Bulls dynasty — Michael Jordan's six titles are the Bulls dynasty.
  • Event: NBA Finals — Michael Jordan went six-for-six in the NBA Finals.
  • Faction: Dream Team — Michael Jordan starred on the 1992 Dream Team.

What is Michael Jordan?

Michael Jordan led the Chicago Bulls to six NBA championships in the 1990s, two three-peats around a baseball retirement, and became the league's defining commercial face.

Key threads lead to Chicago Bulls, Bulls dynasty, NBA Finals and Dream Team.
